title: phyllorkis crassifolia
intro: Phyllorkis crassifolia, commonly known as Plectranthus crassifolius, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine, valued for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of fever, colds, and respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating a range of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Phyllorkis crassifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
